theater: 北敘利亞奧龍特斯河谷

battle.name: 第三次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 北敘利亞奧龍特斯河谷
battle.brief: 公元前1451至1449年，埃及新王國法老圖特摩斯三世第三次北征敘利亞，在奧龍特斯河谷與卡迭施王為首的聯軍陷入苦戰，營中更爆發大疫，遠征草草收束。卡面埃及月牙劍是埃及步兵的近身兵器：弓兵與車兵擾亂敵陣，月牙劍以一擊不回抽的弧刃完成貼身砍殺。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 第三次敘利亞戰役是埃及新王國第十八王朝與北敘利亞、迦南諸邦聯盟之間的第三輪較量，通常定於公元前1451年至1449年，對應圖特摩斯三世在位第29至31年，編制與陣容都屬於美吉多之戰（第二次敘利亞戰役）之後那一系列遠征之列。埃及方面以法老圖特摩斯三世（孟赫佩拉）為最高統帥，宮廷設丞相（維齊爾）乃西、王室書記官，以及阿蒙神廟隨軍的祭司隊；軍隊由步兵（射手與持月牙劍的「強臂」）、六輻輕戰車的車兵、王之近衛，以及努比亞人與麥德雅蠻族等輔助部隊組成，另有工兵、掘壕隊、供水隊、搬運隊與隨軍書記。敘利亞—迦南聯盟以卡迭施王為核心，聯結阿勒頗、圖尼普等城邦與埃及的阿穆魯附庸，車兵編制與武器來源往往得自赫梯一系的北方技術傳統，米坦尼在幕後的支持則為後世學者普遍推測。聯軍在奧龍特斯河谷與幼發拉底河上游一線佈防，卡迭施王居中統兵；埃及的指揮極簡，決戰與追擊由國王本人帶領，分路交給王子與資深將領，戰況由書記官逐日抄錄，日後刻上卡納克阿蒙神廟的編年史牆。
countriesEn: The Third Syrian War was the third round of reckoning between the Egyptian New Kingdom and a coalition of northern Syrian and Canaanite polities, conventionally dated to 1451-1449 BC and thus to regnal years 29 to 31 of Thutmose III, and belonging to the same series of expeditions as the campaign of Megiddo that made up the Second Syrian War. On the Egyptian side stood the Eighteenth Dynasty under Pharaoh Thutmose III (Menkheperre) as supreme commander, with the usual court apparatus of the vizier Nahsi, royal scribes and a detachment of priests of Amun-Re. His army combined infantry - archers together with the men of the sphtm, the 'strong arm', who fought with the khopesh - with a chariot corps riding six-spoked light chariots, the royal bodyguard of the king's followers, and auxiliaries such as Nubians and Medjay; there were also engineers, trench-diggers, water carriers, porters and campaign scribes. The Syrian-Canaanite coalition was centred on the king of Kadesh and drew in Aleppo, Tunip and other city-states together with Egypt's own Amurru vassals; their chariot lists and weapons tended to derive from the northern world of Hatti and Syria, and the backing of Mitanni is a common inference of later scholarship. The league entrenched in the valley of the Orontes and on the upper Euphrates, with the king of Kadesh holding the centre, while the Egyptian command structure stayed austere: the king himself led the decisive stroke and the pursuit, columns were handed to princes and senior officers, and the course of the campaign was copied day by day by scribes whose text was later carved onto the Annals Wall of the temple of Amun-Re at Karnak.
people: 核心人物當然是法老圖特摩斯三世。他在位第二十一年除母親哈特謝普蘇特同年去世後親政，此後年年北征，把整個王權建立在亞洲的戰功之上。第三次敘利亞戰役是他所有遠征中記載最差的一段：此前一年，埃及把亞洲體系推到極限，本役大軍在敘利亞腹地受阻，營地又流行疫病，他既沒能攻下聯軍的要塞，也沒能像以往那樣在編年史上留下攻城清單；這段「沒有收穫」的年份在他身後被改寫成虔誠的記錄，說他向上帝祈禱，眾神使軍隊恢復。敵方領袖卡迭施王是聯軍的實際統帥，阿勒頗王與圖尼普王亦在聯盟之中，但這些城邦君主的姓名多未留下，戰爭的成敗更多要靠考古材料與後世推算。為這場戰爭留下證據的是一批王室書記官與工匠：他們把逐日行程、繳獲、俘虜與疫病記在羊皮紙上，再由石匠刻上卡納克的編年史牆，而牆上第29年那一段的簡短，正是後人判定第三次敘利亞戰役年代與性質的依據。當代學者如德雷福德、肖與沃爾特斯等人對此役的解釋分歧頗大，爭議集中在第29年遠征是否構成一場獨立的戰役，以及聯軍是否真的在會戰中擊敗了埃及軍隊。
peopleEn: Pharaoh Thutmose III is the central figure. He took sole control of the state in regnal year 21, the year his mother Hatshepsut died, and from then on the whole architecture of his kingship rested on the campaigns he led in Asia. The Third Syrian War is the worst-documented of his expeditions: the king's army was checked in the Syrian interior, disease broke out in the camp, and he took neither the strongholds of the coalition nor the kind of list of spoil that his annals customarily record. That empty year was recast after his death as an act of piety, the king having prayed and the gods having restored his army. On the enemy side the king of Kadesh was the effective commander, with the kings of Aleppo and Tunip inside the league, though the personal names of these rulers are mostly lost, and the outcome of the war has to be reconstructed from archaeology and modern inference. What survives of the war was written down by a handful of royal scribes and craftsmen: they recorded the daily itinerary, the booty, the prisoners and the sickness on parchment, and masons cut the result onto the Annals Wall at Karnak, where the brevity of the entry for year 29 remains the principal evidence used to date and characterise this war. Modern scholars such as Redford, Shaw and von Beckerath differ widely over it, disputing especially whether the campaign of year 29 was a war in its own right, and whether the coalition genuinely defeated the Egyptian army.
kits: 卡面上的埃及月牙劍是這支軍隊的近身主兵器。形制上它是短柄的單刃弧形刀，通長約五十至六十公分，刃口向外彎、內側卻凹成月牙，握柄短而厚，常纏皮帶以便在出汗的手上不滑脫。這種形制並非憑空出現：它由早王朝的「ε」型斧演變而來，中王國之後在新王國定型，公元前1500年前後已大量配發給步兵與王之近衛。它的價值在於砍擊之後不必把刀拔出來重新揮起，刃的外弧會把割開的肉帶進來，一記橫掃即可切入人與護甲之間的縫隙；面對盾牆或城門上的守軍，這種鉤拉兼斬的動作比直劍省力得多。卡面年份定在公元前1500年，正說明它在戰役發生的年代早已是埃及步兵手中的標準裝備。除此之外，這場戰爭還用到：以角、腱與木料製成的複合弓，箭鏃為燧石或青銅；新王國步兵的直木長矛；六輻輕型戰車，每車一御者一射手、駕四匹馬，車前有欄板；青銅鎬與單刃斧；皮包木框的圓形盾牌；攻城用的木梯、撞槌與可拖行的攻城塔；成隊的牛車與驢隊搬運水、穀與柴；以及可拆疊拆卸、在無水路段靠牛拖曳搬過陸地的帆船。營帳、旗幟與飾有聖蛇紋的王家標幟，用來在營地劃出各軍的界線。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card was the close-combat arm of this army. In form it is a short-hafted single-edged curved sword, roughly fifty to sixty centimetres long, the edge bowing outward while the inner side is hollowed away into a crescent; the grip is short and thick and was usually bound with leather so that it would not slip from a sweating hand. The shape did not appear from nowhere: it evolved from the 'epsilon' axe of the Early Dynastic period, was fixed in type during the Middle Kingdom, and by about 1500 BC was already in large-scale issue to the infantry and to the royal bodyguard. Its value lies in the fact that the blow does not have to be drawn back and swung again - the outer curve carries the edge into the wound, and a single sweep can cut into the gap between a man and his armour; against a shield wall or a garrison on a city gate, that hooked cutting motion costs far less effort than a straight sword. The card's date of about 1500 BC therefore says something exact: the khopesh was already standard equipment in the hands of Egyptian infantry at the time this war was fought. Alongside it the war used the composite bow of horn, sinew and wood with flint or bronze arrowheads; the straight wooden spear standard to New Kingdom infantry; the six-spoked light chariot, carrying a driver and an archer and drawn by four horses behind a front rail; bronze pickaxes and single-edged axes; round shields of leather over a wooden frame; scaling ladders, battering rams and movable siege towers; ox-carts and donkey trains carrying water, grain and firewood; and canvas sails that could be struck and hauled overland by oxen where no water route existed. Tents, standards and the royal banner marked with the uraeus laid out the boundaries of each corps in camp.
tactics: 圖特摩斯三世的打法在前幾次遠征中已經定型：全軍於春初從邊境要塞提亞魯出發，經加薩沿「海道」北進，再折入奧龍特斯河谷；重步兵列為中軍與兩翼，國王自居中軍，弓兵在前列或兩翼前出作遮蔽，車兵用於衝擊敵陣的薄弱處或掩護步兵接近。攻城則靠壕溝、木柵、撞槌與攻城塔，奪城之後照例不毀城，而是收編當地王公、扣留人質、重設徵貢。第一次敘利亞戰役的教訓有二：一是不能把戰車隊塞在一處窄地讓聯軍先手展開，二是補給線越拉越長，遠征的成敗往往決定在飲水與糧食而不在戰鬥。第三次敘利亞戰役正好把這兩點推到極限：埃及軍在敘利亞腹地與聯軍對峙，既未能迅速決定戰鬥，又因行軍過遠而使營中的飲水、糧食與衛生難以維持，據編年史記載，軍中爆發大疫，士氣與戰鬥力一落千丈，遠征因此提前收束，軍隊撤回埃及。等下一次遠征（第30、31年）時，埃及的作法變成先鞏固加薩與比布魯斯一線的基地與倉儲，再分段推進，而不是一次深入到底。
tacticsEn: Thutmose III's method had already hardened through the earlier campaigns: the army set out at the beginning of the year from the border fortress of Tjaru, moved through Gaza along the coast road, and then turned up the valley of the Orontes; heavy infantry formed the centre and the wings, the king held the middle with his bodyguard, archers screened the front or the flanks, and the chariots were used to strike weak points in the enemy line or to cover the approach of infantry. Cities were taken by ditch, palisade, ram and tower, and once taken they were normally left standing, their princes turned into vassals and hostages, and the tribute system rewritten. The First Syrian War had taught two hard lessons: never to compress the chariot corps into narrow ground where the enemy could deploy first, and never to let the line of supply stretch so far that the campaign was decided by water and grain rather than by battle. The Third Syrian War pushed both points to their limit. The Egyptian army was held in the Syrian interior, could not force a decision, and because it had marched so far, water, food and hygiene in the camp were hard to sustain; the annals record a great pestilence breaking out among the troops, morale and fighting strength fell away, and the expedition was wound up early, the army withdrawing to Egypt. In the following years (30 and 31) the Egyptian practice was to consolidate the bases and depots along Gaza and Byblos first and then advance in stages, instead of driving straight to the far end of the line.
data: 年代方面：卡片年份欄取公元前1455年，而第三次敘利亞戰役通常定於公元前1451至1449年（即圖特摩斯三世在位第29至31年），兩者相差數年：卡片年份沿用「敘利亞戰爭」編號表的排序位次（第二次記公元前1456年、第五次記公元前1450年），並非戰役的確切起訖年，撰稿時以史家通常採用的一段為準。更早的年表曾把整組遠征放在公元前1450年或1451年，高年代則整體推後數十年。行程方面可借第23年美吉多之戰的編年史作參照：全軍自提亞魯出發，十日抵加薩，休息一日，再走約十一日抵達耶海姆；從加薩到卡迭施與幼發拉底河一線，尚有數百公里，換算約半個月至兩個月的行程。兵力方面，卡納克編年史中唯一詳細的數字出自第23年：埃及方面二萬人、一千輛戰車，聯軍一萬至一萬五千人；學者一般認為第29年遠征的實際作戰兵力在一萬上下，車兵數百輛，另有大量搬運與供水人員。疫病造成的減員確切數字沒有留下，只能確定它足以令這次遠征無法完成既定目標。圍城方面，本役沒有留下可核實的攻城日數，這與第二次敘利亞戰役中七個月的美吉多之圍形成鮮明對比；唯一可確定的，是疫病在營地流行開來、軍隊提早回師。
dataEn: On dates: the card's year field takes 1455 BC, while the Third Syrian War is conventionally dated to 1451-1449 BC, that is to regnal years 29 to 31 of Thutmose III; the two differ by a few years, because the card's year follows the ordering of the numbered list of Syrian Wars (the Second is entered as 1456 BC, the Fifth as 1450 BC) rather than the exact span of the campaign, and this account follows the range normally used by historians. Older chronologies placed the whole group of expeditions in 1450 or 1451 BC, while the high chronology shifts everything later by several decades. On movement, the itinerary recorded for year 23 can serve as a yardstick: the army set out from Tjaru, reached Gaza in ten days, rested one day and marched a further eleven days to Yehem; from Gaza to the line of Kadesh and the Euphrates lay several hundred kilometres, something like a month to two months of marching. On numbers of men, the only detailed figure in the Karnak annals comes from year 23: 20,000 men and 1,000 chariots for the Egyptians against 10,000 to 15,000 for the coalition; scholars generally put the actual field strength of the year-29 expedition at around 10,000, with some hundreds of chariots and a large train of porters and water carriers. No exact figure survives for the losses caused by the disease, only that they were sufficient to prevent the expedition from achieving its objectives. On the siege, this war leaves no verifiable number of days under the walls, in sharp contrast to the seven months spent before Megiddo in the Second Syrian War; the only certainty is that the pestilence spread through the camp and the army came home early.
cause: 起因有三層。遠因是埃及自第十八王朝以來在黎凡特建立的秩序：加薩、比布魯斯、阿拉非克等港口與內陸商路構成血脈，阿穆魯地區的附庸邦按年進貢，沿海與河谷的城鎮提供穀物、象牙與人力。這套體系並不是靠駐軍維持的，而是靠國王每年帶著大軍北上重整一遍——一旦某一年沒有打贏，貢賦就會停，附庸就會試探。第一層近因是美吉多之後埃及的邊界推得太前：最遠的據點已近幼發拉底河，距離卡納克上千公里，任何一場戰役的失敗都會直接回饋到首都的財政與聲望。第二層近因是北方的聯盟重建：卡迭施王與阿勒頗、圖尼普等城邦重新結盟，車兵編制與武器來源往往與赫梯、米坦尼的北方體系相通，聯軍佔據家鄉地形，進可攻、退可守。第三層則在埃及自身：哈特謝普蘇特死後的權力清洗告一段落，王權需要新的戰功來鞏固，而國王本人在連年消耗中也需要一場能帶回戰利品的遠征來兌現其合法性。於是遠征成了義務：打，也要打。
causeEn: The causes work on three levels. The distant one is the order Egypt had built in the Levant since the Eighteenth Dynasty: the harbours of Gaza, Byblos and Arwad and the inland caravan roads formed its blood supply, the vassal states of Amurru paid tribute by the year, and the coastal and river-valley towns provided grain, ivory and labour. That system was not held by garrisons but by the king himself, who marched north with a great army every year to put it back in order; and if a single year went badly, the tribute stopped and the vassals began to test the limits. The first proximate cause lies in how far Egypt had pushed its frontier after Megiddo: the furthest strongholds now stood close to the Euphrates, a thousand kilometres from Karnak, so any defeat in the field fed straight back into the finances and prestige of the capital. The second proximate cause is the reconstruction of the northern league: the king of Kadesh drew together Aleppo, Tunip and other cities, with chariot lists and weapon supplies that usually ran through the northern systems of Hatti and Mitanni, while the league held the advantage of its own ground, able to attack or withdraw at will. The third level lies inside Egypt itself: the purge that followed the death of Hatshepsut had run its course, the crown needed fresh military achievement to confirm itself, and a king worn down by repeated campaigning needed a victory that would pay. The expedition therefore became an obligation - the war had to be fought, whether or not it could be won.
impact: 影響有兩條線。一條是關於軍隊與國家的：這場戰爭留下的最重要記錄，是人類已知最早的軍隊疫病記載之一——編年史上「營中大疫」幾個字背後，是數千名士兵在缺水、少糧、擁擠的營地裡集體病倒，軍隊幾乎在勝負尚未分明的時候就自己崩解。從此之後，埃及的遠征在制度上更看重給水、病患的處置與收縮戰線的時機，這些細節在後來阿馬爾納時期的軍隊管理與後世希臘羅馬的野戰手冊中都能找到影子。另一條線是關於國際秩序的：這次沒有收穫的遠征，恰恰把圖特摩斯三世的注意力推向更北、更難拔的對手米坦尼；其後的第33年遠征，他命人造船並把船隻拖過陸地強渡幼發拉底河，攻下卡爾凱美什，終於把埃及的邊界推到了米坦尼的腹地。此後百年，幼發拉底河一線成為埃及與米坦尼反覆爭奪的邊界，而這條線的第一推力，正是第三次敘利亞戰役這一類僵持的遠征。對埃及自身而言，這場戰爭還提醒了後世君主：帝國的邊防拉得太長，就會像這次一樣，贏得了會戰也守不住政權。
impactEn: The consequences run along two lines. The first concerns the army and the state: the most important thing this war left behind is one of the earliest known records of disease in a military camp - behind the few words about a great pestilence in the annals lies a picture of thousands of soldiers falling ill together in a camp short of water, short of grain and dangerously crowded, the army collapsing of itself before the battle was decided. Egyptian expeditions afterwards paid more attention in practice to water supply, the disposition of the sick and the timing of withdrawal, and those habits can be traced in the military administration of the Amarna period and in the field manuals of the later Greek and Roman world. The second line concerns the international order: precisely because this expedition brought home nothing, it pushed Thutmose III's attention northward towards the harder opponent, Mitanni. In the year-33 campaign that followed, he had ships built, dragged them overland and force-crossed the Euphrates to take Carchemish, carrying Egypt's frontier into Mitannian territory. From then on the Euphrates line was the frontier over which Egypt and Mitanni fought for a century, and the first push on that line came from a series of stalled expeditions of the kind the Third Syrian War represents. For Egypt itself the war carried a warning to later rulers: a frontier stretched too long can lose the government even while it wins its battles.
result: 結果是僵局，而不是失敗。第29年的遠征沒有攻城紀錄，軍隊因疫病提前回師，埃及既沒有被逐出迦南，也沒有取得新的土地；次年與再下一年的遠征重整了阿穆魯的附庸與貢賦，北進的旗幟重新立回加薩與奧龍特斯河谷。從更長的視角看，第三次敘利亞戰役沒有解決它提出的任何問題：卡迭施依然不肯低頭，米坦尼的影響依然站在聯盟背後，幼發拉底河依然是一道沒有解決的邊界。真正的解決要等到圖特摩斯三世晚年的第33年遠征，他強渡幼發拉底河、奪取卡爾凱美什，才把這場僵持變成另一場僵持；再往後是阿肯納頓時期的全面崩解，以及赫梯自北方南下與巴比倫趁勢東來的介入。於是第三次敘利亞戰役在史上的位置十分特別：它在埃及的編年史上是一行簡短的失敗記錄，卻是理解這位尚武之王的一把鑰匙——它顯示這支在美吉多輝煌過的軍隊，同樣會因一場熱病而掉頭；也顯示以國王年年北征維繫的附庸體系，本質上脆弱得經不起連續兩年的失敗。卡面上的月牙劍提醒我們，在那樣的遠征裡，決定勝負的常常不是弧刃本身，而是軍營裡的水井。
resultEn: The result was a stalemate rather than a defeat. The expedition of year 29 left no record of a siege, the army came home early because of the disease, and Egypt was neither driven out of Canaan nor given new land; the expeditions of the two following years restored the vassals of Amurru and the tribute system, and the flag of the advance was planted again along Gaza and the Orontes valley. In the longer view the Third Syrian War settled none of the problems it raised: Kadesh would not bow, the influence of Mitanni still stood behind the league, and the Euphrates remained an unresolved frontier. The real solution came only in the year-33 campaign of the king's later reign, when the forced crossing of the Euphrates and the capture of Carchemish turned one stalemate into another; after that came the general collapse of the Amarna period, and the intervention of Hatti coming down from the north while Babylonia pressed in from the east. The Third Syrian War therefore occupies an unusual place in history: in the Egyptian annals it is a single brief line recording a failure, yet it is a key to understanding this warlike king. It shows that the army which had shone at Megiddo could also turn back because of a fever, and it shows that a system of vassalage held together by the king's annual campaigns was in truth fragile enough to be shaken by two consecutive unsuccessful years. The khopesh on the card carries the reminder that in an expedition of that kind, what often decided the issue was not the crescent blade but the wells in the camp.
